SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date May 26, 1938
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.B. REGISTRY No. D.859.2(C) Date MAY 26, 1938）
Confidential Drawer
Subject Mutual Agreement concluded between the local Italian
-and Japanese Military Defence Authorities
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.I.

There is a rumour to the effect that the local
Italian and Japanese Military Defence Authorities have
concluded a mutual agreement which was agreed to on
May 15, and is in the following terms :-
(1) That in the event of any attack, occurring on
extra-Settlement roads situated within the
defence perimeter of the Italian Naval Landing
Units, on Japanese military detachments by
Chinese guerilla units, who are to be regarded
as the Communist mobile units, assistance be
rendered by the Italian Defence Force in the
ensuing fight.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 20 MAY 1938 SPECIAL BRANCH）
(2) That in a state of emergency, the Italian Units
so engaged be temporarily placed under the
control of the Japanese Military.
(3) That in the event of any incident occurring
beyond the defence perimeter of the Italian
Naval Landing Units and should assistance be
required by the Japanese Military, mutual
co-operation be effected by the Italian
Defence Force.
(4) That in the event of the Italian Defence Units
be attacked, assistance be rendered accordingly
by the Japanese Military Authorities.

S.1，特别处
报告
日期：1938年5月26日
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别处登记处 编号 D.859.2(C) 日期 1938年5月26日）
机密卷宗
事由：当地意大利与日本军事防卫当局缔结的互惠协定
由督察顾保华（Kuh Pao-hwa）撰写，经督察 C. Crawford 转呈

有传闻称，当地意大利与日本军事防卫当局已缔结一项互惠协定，该协定于5月15日达成同意，条款如下：

(1) 若位于意大利海军陆战队防卫圈内的越界筑路区域发生中国游击队（被视为共产党机动部队）袭击日军分遣队的事件，意大利防卫部队应在随后的战斗中提供援助。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1938年5月20日 特别处）

(2) 在紧急状态下，上述参与行动的意大利部队应暂时置于日本军方的控制之下。

(3) 若在意大利海军陆战队防卫圈之外发生任何事件，且日本军方需要援助，意大利防卫部队应进行相互合作。

(4) 若意大利防卫部队遭受攻击，日本军事当局应相应地提供援助。
